questions.q: Tacking in garment construction is best described as:
options: A permanent decorative stitch on the collar.
A temporary stitch used to hold pieces of fabric together before permanent sewing.
The process of cutting out the pattern pieces.
questions.explain: Tacking (or basting) stitches are long, temporary stitches made to keep fabric pieces securely in place until permanent machine or hand sewing is done.

questions.q: Making simple crafts like 'Tie and Dye' or 'Beadwork' at home can be highly beneficial to a family because:
options: It wastes the family's free time.
It is an income-yielding craft that can generate extra money for the family.
It is the only way to get clothes.
questions.explain: Crafts such as tie and dye, bead making, and knitting can be sold for profit, thereby providing a secondary source of income for the family.
